rule: One line of .env gives one key and value, or nothing, exactly as the dotenv package the bot loads reads it. Null key and value mean the line assigns nothing.

cases.name: a plain assignment
nothing after the equals sign is an empty value
only spaces after the equals sign is an empty value
empty double quotes are an empty value
empty single quotes are an empty value
spaces around the key, the equals sign and the value are dropped
a space before the equals sign is allowed
a tab before the key is dropped
spaces inside an unquoted value are kept
an unquoted value ends at a # that has a space before it
an unquoted value ends at a # that has no space before it
an unquoted value ends at a # that has a tab before it
an unquoted value ends at the first of two #
an unquoted value that starts with # is empty
a # inside double quotes is kept
a # inside single quotes is kept
a # inside backticks is kept
a comment after a double-quoted value is dropped
a comment straight after a single-quoted value, with no space, is dropped
spaces inside quotes are kept
one space in quotes is a value of one space
spaces outside the quotes are dropped
a single quote inside double quotes is kept
a double quote inside single quotes is kept
both other quote kinds inside backticks are kept
a quote in the middle of an unquoted value is kept
export before the key is dropped
export followed by a tab is dropped
export with spaces around the equals sign
export with nothing between it and the equals sign is the key itself
export joined to the key is part of the key
export and a key with no equals sign assigns nothing
a colon and a space works like an equals sign
a colon with no space after it assigns nothing
a commented-out assignment assigns nothing
an indented comment assigns nothing
a blank line assigns nothing
a line with no equals sign assigns nothing
a line with no key assigns nothing
a double quote that never closes is kept as part of the value
a single quote that never closes is kept as part of the value
a double quote that never closes, then a #: cut at the #, quote kept
backslash n inside double quotes becomes a line break
backslash n inside double quotes becomes a line break even when a combining accent follows it
backslash r inside double quotes becomes a carriage return
backslash t inside double quotes stays as written
two backslashes then n inside double quotes: one backslash stays, then a line break
backslash n inside single quotes stays as written
backslash n in an unquoted value stays as written
backslash n after a double quote that never closes still becomes a line break
a backslash before a double quote lets it sit inside double quotes; the backslash stays
a backslash before a single quote lets it sit inside single quotes; the backslash stays
text after the closing quote: the value is no longer quoted, so the quotes stay
two quoted parts: only the outermost pair of quotes is removed
a quote inside the same kind of quotes: only the outermost pair is removed
three double quotes are a value of one double quote
a # inside quotes followed by more text: cut at the #, opening quote kept
an equals sign inside the value is kept
a dollar reference is not expanded
a key may contain a dot
a key may contain a hyphen
a key may start with a digit
a key may be lower case
a key with a letter outside A to Z assigns nothing
a value with a letter outside A to Z is kept
a carriage return at the end of the line is not part of the value
